title: Agents in the Large: Perception-Centered Architecture for Persistent Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.30478v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Cognitive language agents have achieved substantial progress by equipping language models with memory, tools, and decision-making procedures, enabling agents to reason and act in interactive environments. Existing frameworks largely cast these agents as systems for solving user-specified, bounded tasks. An increasingly important goal is for language agents to provide persistent assistance in long-lived settings where user needs, context, and service procedures persist and change, and to remain useful across the broad range of tasks that arise over time. Yet we still lack a framework to characterize persistent AI agents, organize existing work, and guide future development. To this end, we propose a Perception-Centered Architecture for Persistent Agents (Pera). translated_title: 大规模智能体：面向持久智能体的以感知为中心的架构
translated_abstract: 认知语言智能体通过为语言模型配备记忆、工具和决策程序，使其能够在交互环境中进行推理和行动，从而取得了实质性进展。现有框架大多将这些智能体视为解决用户指定的、有界任务的系统。一个日益重要的目标是让语言智能体在长期存在的环境中提供持久辅助——在这种环境中，用户需求、上下文和服务流程会持续存在并不断变化，并且智能体需要随时间推移在出现的广泛任务范围内保持有用性。然而，我们目前仍缺乏一个能够刻画持久AI智能体、组织现有工作并指导未来发展的框架。为此，我们提出了一种面向持久智能体的以感知为中心的架构。Pera 描述了一个围绕感知与控制组件组织的持久智能体，这些组件持续感知来自情景任务执行、内部控……（摘要内容在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了Pera——一种以感知为中心的持久智能体架构，通过持续感知来自任务执行和内部状态的服务相关信号，使语言智能体能够在长期环境中应对不断变化的用户需求并提供持久辅助。
en_tdlr: Proposes Pera, a perception-centered architecture for persistent agents that continuously perceives service-relevant signals from episodic task executions and internal states, enabling language agents to provide persistent assistance amid evolving user needs in long-lived settings.
